title: Peter Confesses Jesus as the Messiah and the Teaching on the Cross
description: While Jesus is praying alone with his disciples, he asks them who the people say he is, and Peter confesses him as God's Messiah. Jesus predicts his suffering, death, and resurrection on the third day, teaching that whoever wants to follow him must deny themselves and take up their cross daily. He warns against being ashamed of him and promises that some will see the Kingdom of God before they die.
